description: Update fields on an existing event: name, event_date, description, tag, access_code, album_quality (storage resolution; changeable only before the first photo is uploaded, and tier-capped), enable_downloads (toggle guest downloads on/off), or is_collaborative (toggle whether other people can upload). Only include the fields you want to change. Use when the photographer wants to rename, re-date, re-code, change quality (pre-upload), or flip the downloads/collaborative toggles. If the photographer asks to change album_quality on an album that already has photos, the API will return a `conflict` error — relay that politely and explain they'd need to delete photos first.

album_quality.description: Storage resolution. Changeable only before the first photo is uploaded; tier-capped.

is_collaborative.description: Whether other people can upload to this album.

name: update_event
